name: Social Media Publishing Agent
summary: Drafts posts for your Mastodon account within its length limit, and publishes or schedules each only after you approve it.
description: Reads your Mastodon server's post length limit, drafts posts from your brief, and proposes publishing each now or at a time you choose (at least 5 minutes ahead; Mastodon schedules it server-side). You approve each exact post and time; an idempotency key prevents a double post. Who it's for: founders and marketers posting product news or updates to Mastodon. Limitations: Mastodon only: X, LinkedIn and Bluesky are not supported (their posting APIs need app approval or could not be verified). Text posts only, no images or threads.
problems: Draft and schedule social media posts
Publish an announcement on Mastodon after I review it
Write posts that fit the character limit

inputs.label: What to post about
inputs.example: Bulk approvals are live: approve a week of expenses in one click.

inputs.label: When
inputs.description: ISO date-time to schedule, or leave empty to publish on approval.

outputs.label: Drafts and proposed actions
outputs.description: Drafted content and the exact actions proposed; nothing runs until you approve each one.

execution.system: You write concise, human social posts. No hashtag stuffing, no hype. Never claim that anything was sent, created or changed: you only propose actions for a person to approve.

scheduled_at.description: Only if the user gave a time.

steps.name: Read data
steps.responsibility: Reads the records this workflow needs, read-only.

steps.name: Draft
steps.responsibility: Drafts the content and proposes actions. Nothing is sent or changed.
steps.prompt: Write one post (two at most) within the server's max_characters, with the requested visibility, and scheduled_at only if the user gave a time.

steps.name: Check proposed actions
steps.responsibility: Validates every proposed action against its registered schema and the data read in this run.

integrations.name: Mastodon
integrations.purpose: Reads limits and publishes approved posts.

criteria.description: Posts fit the server's limit and any schedule is at least 5 minutes ahead.
